name: movie_iotaori_lpqi_orbit
label: Movie: iota Ori Aa through one 29-day orbit on the LPQI-Pathfinder, eight nights every 3.64 d (650 nm red continuum, MPD)
notes: The best northern binary for the Pathfinder's geometric-distance measurement: V 2.8, separation up to 1.9 mas (several fringes per night), both stars unresolved at 530 m, and a distance in dispute (Hipparcos 714 pc vs the eclipsing orbit's 412 pc).
Eight nights every 3.64 d (P/8) step the eccentric orbit by 0.125 in mean anomaly: separations 0.2-1.9 mas, no eclipses (i 63 deg).

One red continuum filter (650 nm, proposed) for all nights: the least-resolved disks, the best fringe contrast and the 35 ps MPD, without sitting in H-alpha where the O9 III wind may alter the flux ratio. Bluer filters and red/blue mixes were computed to be worse on every parameter.
Third light 0.07 from the tertiary Ab at 155 mas. node_pa_deg 0 assumed. The closing act fits all nights for the orbit's scale and node angle.
